services.browser_reference: Kakao Map / Roadview public links; see services.md. No Kakao or Naver automation adapter is installed by this pack.

tips.municipal: Read Korean road-name/building-number plates and municipal issuing authorities, then verify the full address on juso.go.kr. Keep all same-name candidates; a business address is not the camera position.
tips.livery: A bus operator, route number or livery is a hypothesis only; routes cross administrative boundaries. Verify the route and a visible stop name before narrowing.
tips.street_view: For a justified KR candidate, compare nearby public ground-level images and Kakao Roadview if accessible. gsv.py covers Google only; a Google lookup failure does not imply no Korean street imagery. Record unavailable browser/API access instead of inventing a match.
